gaps.sentence: The results were inconclusive. ___, the team repeated the whole experiment.
gaps.explanation: The inconclusive results caused the repetition: Therefore is the only result linker.

gaps.sentence: ___ being the youngest competitor, she won the gold medal.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite being...' is the standard concessive pattern with a gerund.

gaps.sentence: City rents are crippling. In the countryside, ___, property is far cheaper.
gaps.explanation: 'On the other hand' moves to a contrasting (not opposite) situation.
'Firstly' opens a sequence of instructions; eventually/finally close one.

gaps.sentence: I know exactly what the risks are. ___, I'm going anyway.
gaps.hint: doing it in spite of risk

gaps.sentence: Nobody volunteered to stay late, ___ Tomas.
gaps.explanation: 'Apart from Tomas' = except for Tomas, the only person who volunteered.

gaps.sentence: ___ it rains all weekend, the ceremony will still be held outdoors.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a possible (not yet real) condition.

gaps.sentence: The drug is remarkably effective. ___, it has almost no side effects.
gaps.explanation: 'Furthermore' introduces an additional point supporting the same claim.
